$comment: Schedule-only copy of BC Transit's operator 13 feed, used as an overlay in Metro Vancouver where the Fraser Valley routes reach Lougheed. The live feed is bc-transit-fraser-valley in the Fraser Valley region; overlays cannot carry bus real time (docs/DESIGN.md#overlay-feeds).
name: BC Transit (Fraser Valley overlay)
$timezoneChecks: BC moved to permanent UTC-7 in 2026 (tzdata 2026b, https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tzdb/NEWS); the server refuses to start with older time zone data.

timezoneChecks.reason: British Columbia's permanent UTC-7 (tzdata 2026b or later)

static.$comment: Same operator 13 export as the Fraser Valley primary feed. Kept separate because overlays are timetable-only.

display.$tripId: Consat trip ids begin with the journey id.
display.$feedVersion: Versions begin with an export date and sequence number.
